name: Thanatophobia
summary: The fear of death. Venture through different levels that can lead to other levels or be a dead end. There are 3 paths that were crafted by 3 beings each path leads you to all kinds of levels some being safe while others.. being not so safe. you might ask yourself. what do i do if i fall out of the world or hit a dead end level? well your in luck because the chimps have invented new technology to warp you back to spawn.
